feature.description: the **feature** name this review relates to

ready.description: whether the reviewer believed that the code is "production ready"

spec.description: the underlying _specification file_ that this review is based on

created.description: an ISO8601 representation of the date and time this review was created (using host's timezone)

agent.description: a string representation of agent and model: `${agent}/${model}`

implemented.description: boolean flag indicating whether this review's suggestions has been implemented

next.description: the _next_ feature review that was conducted

previous.description: the _prior- feature review that was conducted

findings.description: every finding, high, medium, and low, each as `<ID> (<priority>): <title>`; only a high finding makes `ready` false

observations.description: titles of issues the reviewer noticed that do not block readiness (outside the spec, or not reachable by a realistic input); the author either schedules a fix or lets it go, and none is repaired in the current cycle

human_in_the_loop.description: only on a first review that stopped for a human, the critical decisions the author must make (plain language, options with pros and cons, a recommendation); `null` when the first review found nothing that needs a human; while unresolved, `just fix` opens an interactive session to settle them

human_resolved.description: set to `true` once the author's decisions are recorded under `## Human Rulings` (by the interactive decisions session or by hand); the next review will not start while a non-empty `human_in_the_loop` is unresolved

human_review.description: whether a human review is still wanted AFTER the review/fix cycle (it never blocks `ready`)

human_review_items.description: what the human should review when `human_review` is true

has_blocked_findings.description: whether any finding is blocked on that human review

blocked.description: whether ALL findings are blocked on that human review

next_spec.description: in a multi-spec pipeline, the next spec (a path)

next_plan.description: in a multi-spec pipeline, the plan beside the next spec

refresh.description: historical: earlier reviews refreshed the next spec and plan of a multi-spec pipeline; the implementation's final phase does this now

refresh_changes.description: what the refresh changed in the next spec and plan, in plain language

refresh_human_items.description: the contested refresh decisions a human must make
